`send_receipt` in `services/notifier/notifier/email.py` now switches to a new `receipt_v2` template when `NOTIFIER_FF_NEW_RECEIPT_EMAIL=1`. With the variable unset or any other value, it sends the existing `receipt` template. Both tests pass.

- **Flag style:** I used an env var because the notifier is deployed separately and can't read the root `flags.toml`, per the project convention. It's read on each call, so you can change it per deployment without a code change.
- **Test:** I added one that checks the flag-on path picks `receipt_v2`.
- **Template missing:** There is no new receipt template in the repo. `services/notifier/templates/` doesn't exist and `render()` is still a stub. I didn't invent content, so turning the flag on will fail until `receipt_v2.mjml` and a matching `receipt_v2.txt` exist. The project convention requires the plain-text twin, with the same snake_case variables.
- **Gradual rollout:** The flag is all-or-nothing per deployment. A percentage-based rollout would need extra logic, such as hashing the invoice id. Tell me if you want that.
